edit.description: the put-down bullet's absence clause states the shape the engine composes when no window is declared, and its thresholds name a fact that line carries

summary: The put-down bullet tells build no budget line means no declared window; the engine sends a line carrying elapsed and tool calls and no percentage, so that clause never fires
acceptance: the put-down bullet names a threshold against a fact the composed line actually carries, and its absence clause states the real no-window shape — a line with no percentage — instead of a missing line, whose three causes are transcript failures
notes: Verified at `src/budgetLine.ts:186`-`:200`: with no window declared the line still renders, elapsed and tool calls alone. A missing line is one of three transcript failures (`:146`-`:171`), none a chain's declaration. No chain can declare a window yet (THE-DECLARATION-FORWARDS-THE-CONTEXT-WINDOW), so every build tick today reads 70%/80% of a window its line never states. Which dial the second arm names is parked. Prompt prose, so no property.
